description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - First Meeting to elect the Chairman of the Hanguranketha Pradeshiya Sabha in the Nuwara Eliya District - First meeting to elect the Chairman of the Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale Pradeshiya Sabha in the Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the scheduling of meetings to elect Chairmen for local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It falls under election-related administrative matters, specifically covering election procedures and schedules for local government positions, which aligns perfectly with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for electoral processes and related matters.
